symptoms: Necrotic spots with distinct vein-limited margins
Leaf chlorosis surrounding the necrotic tissues
causes: Oomycete pathogen Phytophthora infestans
High humidity and cool to moderate temperatures

treatment.howToUse: 2-3 grams of Mancozeb per liter of water
treatment.whenToRepeat: Repeat after rain if symptoms persist
treatment.safetyPrecautions: Wear gloves and mask; avoid spraying in strong wind
treatment.organicAlternative: Copper-based fungicides or Bacillus subtilis based biocontrol agents
treatment.labelWarning: Follow the product label and local agricultural guidance before applying any treatment.

watering.frequency: Water when the top 1 inch of soil is dry
watering.overwateringWarning: Can cause tuber rot and favor fungal pathogens
watering.underwateringWarning: Stunts growth and reduces tuber size

fertilizer.howToApply: Side dressing away from the stem

prevention: Remove and destroy infected plant debris immediately

ta.summary: இது உருளைக்கிழங்கு பயிரை தாக்கும் ஒரு தீவிரமான பூஞ்சை நோய். இலையில் பழுப்பு நிற புள்ளிகள் தோன்றும்.
ta.treatmentGuide: மன்கோசெப் (Mancozeb) மருந்தை ஒரு லிட்டர் தண்ணீருக்கு 2-3 கிராம் கலந்து தெளிக்கவும்.
ta.wateringGuide: மண்ணின் ஈரப்பதத்தைப் பொறுத்து நீர் பாய்ச்சவும், அதிக நீர் தேங்காமல் பார்த்துக் கொள்ளவும்.
ta.sunlightGuide: தினமும் 6-8 மணி நேரம் சூரிய ஒளி தேவை.
ta.preventionGuide: தரமான விதைகளைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள் மற்றும் பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றவும்.

tanglish.summary: Idhu urulaikilangu payirai thakkum oru veemana poonjai noi.
tanglish.treatmentGuide: Mancozeb marunthai oru liter thanneeril 2-3 gram kalanthu thelikkavum.
tanglish.wateringGuide: Mannin eerappathathai parthu neer paaychavum, adhigamaga neer thengavida vendam.
tanglish.sunlightGuide: Dhinamum 6-8 mani neram sooriya oli vendum.
tanglish.preventionGuide: Tharamana vithaigalai payanpaduthungal matrum baadhikkapatta chedigaalai udane agattruungal.

symptoms: Irregular, water-soaked brown lesions on leaves
Yellow halo surrounding the necrotic areas
Visible yellowing and wilting of leaf tissue
Necrosis following the veins of the leaf
causes: Phytophthora infestans (oomycete pathogen)
High humidity and cool to moderate temperatures

treatment.howToUse: Mix 2-3g of Mancozeb per liter of water.
treatment.whenToRepeat: Repeat if high humidity or rainfall persists.
treatment.safetyPrecautions: Wear mask, gloves, and protective clothing during application.
treatment.organicAlternative: Copper-based fungicides or Bacillus subtilis biocontrol agents.
treatment.labelWarning: Follow the product label and local agricultural guidance before applying any treatment.

watering.frequency: Irrigate when top 1 inch of soil is dry
watering.overwateringWarning: Avoid waterlogging as it promotes fungal rot
watering.underwateringWarning: Avoid drought stress which weakens plant immunity

sunlight.lackOfSunlightSigns: Stunted growth and poor tuber development

prevention: Remove and destroy infected plant debris immediately
Improve air circulation through proper plant spacing
Practice crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops

ta.summary: இது உருளைக்கிழங்கு பயிரை தாக்கும் ஒரு தீவிரமான பூஞ்சை நோயாகும். இலைகளில் பழுப்பு நிற புள்ளிகள் மற்றும் மஞ்சள் நிற வளையங்கள் தென்படுகின்றன.
symptoms: இலைகளில் நீர் நிறைந்த பழுப்பு நிற புள்ளிகள்
ta.treatmentGuide: மேன்கோசெப் (Mancozeb) மருந்தை 1 லிட்டர் தண்ணீருக்கு 2-3 கிராம் என்ற அளவில் கலந்து தெளிக்கவும்.
ta.wateringGuide: மண்ணின் மேற்பரப்பு காய்ந்ததும் தண்ணீர் பாய்ச்சவும். தேங்காமல் பார்த்துக்கொள்ளவும்.
ta.sunlightGuide: தினமும் 6-8 மணி நேரம் நேரடி சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம்.
ta.preventionGuide: நோய் இல்லாத தரமான விதைகளைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றி அழித்து விடுங்கள்.

tanglish.summary: Idhu potato payirai thakkum oru veekramana poonjai noi. Ilaigalil brown nira pulligal thondrugiradhu.
tanglish.treatmentGuide: Mancozeb marundhai 1 litre thanneerukku 2-3 gram kalandhu thelikkavum.
tanglish.wateringGuide: Mannin melparappu kainthadhum thanneer paaychavum. Thengaamal paarthukollavum.
tanglish.preventionGuide: Noi illadha vidhaigalai payanpaduthungal. Paadhikkapatta sedigalai agatri azhithu vidungal.

symptoms: Circular brown lesions with yellow chlorotic halos
General yellowing (chlorosis) of the leaf lamina
causes: Bacterial pathogen Xanthomonas citri
Spread by rain splashes, wind, and contaminated pruning tools

treatment.howToUse: Mix 3g of Copper Oxychloride per liter of water.
treatment.whenToRepeat: Repeat if symptoms persist after two weeks or during rainy seasons.
treatment.safetyPrecautions: Wear gloves and mask; avoid spraying in high wind.
treatment.organicAlternative: Neem oil spray (10,000 ppm) or Copper-based organic sprays allowed in organic farming.
treatment.labelWarning: Follow the product label and local agricultural guidance before applying any treatment.

watering.frequency: Every 5-7 days depending on soil drainage
watering.soilMoisture: Consistent moisture in the root zone
watering.overwateringWarning: Avoid standing water to prevent root rot
watering.underwateringWarning: Drought stress can weaken the tree's immune system

fertilizer.howToApply: Apply in a ring around the drip line
fertilizer.precautions: Avoid direct contact with the trunk

sunlight.lackOfSunlightSigns: Leggy growth and reduced fruit yield

prevention: Disinfect pruning tools with 10% bleach solution
Use resistant varieties in future plantings
Avoid overhead irrigation to keep leaves dry

ta.summary: இது பாக்டீரியாவால் ஏற்படும் இலைப்புள்ளி நோய். இலைகளில் மஞ்சள் வளையத்துடன் கூடிய பழுப்பு நிற புள்ளிகள் காணப்படும்.
ta.treatmentGuide: காப்பர் ஆக்சிகுளோரைடு (Copper Oxychloride) மருந்தை 1 லிட்டர் தண்ணீருக்கு 3 கிராம் என்ற அளவில் கலந்து தெளிக்கவும்.
ta.wateringGuide: மண்ணின் ஈரப்பதத்தைப் பொறுத்து வாரம் ஒருமுறை தண்ணீர் பாய்ச்சவும்.
ta.fertilizerGuide: சீரான NPK 10-10-10 உரத்தை தண்டுக்குத் தள்ளி இடவும்.
ta.sunlightGuide: தினமும் 6-8 மணி நேரம் நேரடி சூரிய ஒளி தேவை.
ta.preventionGuide: பாதிக்கப்பட்ட கிளைகளை அகற்றி எரிக்கவும். கருவிகளை கிருமி நீக்கம் செய்யவும்.

tanglish.summary: Idhu bacterial rogathal varum kan-kar nooi. Ilaidhalgalil manjal valayathudan brown pulligal irukkum.
tanglish.treatmentGuide: Copper Oxychloride 3g per litre thanneeril kalandhu thelikavum.
tanglish.wateringGuide: Mannin eerapadathai poruthu varam orumurai thanneer paichavum.
tanglish.sunlightGuide: Dhinamum 6-8 mani neram neradi sooriya oli avasiyam.
tanglish.preventionGuide: Badhikkappatta kilaigalai vettivittu erikkavum. Karuvigalai kirumi neekkam seiyavum.

symptoms: Brown to black concentric rings (target spots) on older leaves
causes: Fungus Alternaria solani
High humidity and warm temperatures (24-29°C)
Prolonged leaf wetness from overhead watering
diseases.treatment: Apply copper-based or Mancozeb fungicide at first sign of disease. Prune infected lower foliage immediately.
diseases.prevention: Practice 3-year crop rotation, space plants for airflow, use drip irrigation, mulch soil to prevent fungal spore splash.

symptoms: White fuzzy mold on underside of leaves in humid conditions
causes: Oomycete Phytophthora infestans
Cool, wet, cloudy weather with rain and fog
diseases.treatment: Apply bio-fungicides or chlorothalonil / copper fungicides. Remove and destroy heavily blighted plants.
diseases.prevention: Plant certified disease-free transplants, keep foliage completely dry, destroy volunteer potato/tomato plants.

symptoms: Dark brown spots on leaves with pale green border
Tuber rot with dry brownish-purple skin lesions
causes: Phytophthora infestans
High moisture combined with cool nights and moderate days
diseases.treatment: Spray systemic or contact fungicides approved for tuber crops. Destroy infected plant debris away from garden.
diseases.prevention: Plant resistant potato varieties, hill soil deeply around tubers, destroy infected cull piles.

symptoms: Spindle-shaped or diamond-shaped lesions with gray/whitish centers and dark borders
Lesions enlarge and kill entire leaves
causes: Fungal pathogen Magnaporthe oryzae
Excessive nitrogen fertilizer and cloudy, damp weather
diseases.treatment: Foliar spray with Tricyclazole or Isoprothiolane at seedling or tillering stage.
diseases.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilization, manage water levels, treat seeds with Trichoderma harzianum.

symptoms: Olive-green to velvety brown velvety spots on upper leaf surfaces
Deformed, corky scabs on developing fruit
causes: Venturia inaequalis fungus overwintering in fallen leaves
Cool, rainy spring weather
diseases.treatment: Apply sulfur or Captan fungicide at green-tip bud break stage before spring rains.
diseases.prevention: Rake and destroy fallen leaves in autumn, prune canopy for maximum sunlight and air circulation.

symptoms: Small circular brown leaf spots with black fruiting bodies (pycnidia)
Berries turn reddish-brown, shrivel, and become hard black mummies
causes: Fungal spores spread by splashing rain in warm, humid weather
diseases.treatment: Apply myclobutanil or copper-based sprays from pre-bloom through 4 weeks post-bloom.
diseases.prevention: Remove all shriveled mummified berries from vines and ground, prune vines for good ventilation.

symptoms: Long, elliptical, grayish-green or tan lesions (cigar-shaped) on leaves
causes: Fungal pathogen surviving in crop residue, favored by moderate temps and wet conditions
diseases.treatment: Foliar fungicides containing strobilurins or triazoles if economic threshold is reached.
diseases.prevention: Till under residue, select resistant corn hybrids, practice crop rotation with non-host crops.

symptoms: Small water-soaked blister-like spots on leaves that turn dark brown with yellow halos
Defoliation and sun-scald on exposed peppers
causes: Bacterial infection transmitted by seed and rain splash in warm humid weather
diseases.treatment: Copper-hydroxide sprays mixed with mancozeb for synergy. Disinfect all pruning tools.
diseases.prevention: Use certified pathogen-free seeds, avoid working in garden when foliage is wet, practice strict rotation.

plant_care.watering: Deeply water 2-3 times per week at the base. Maintain even soil moisture. Never wet the leaves to avoid fungal infection.
plant_care.fertilizer: Balanced organic compost at planting, followed by 5-10-10 or low-nitrogen potassium-rich feed once flowering begins.
plant_care.sunlight: Full direct sunlight for 6 to 8 hours daily. Protect young seedlings from extreme scorching midday heat.

plant_care.watering: Consistent moisture (1-2 inches per week) during tuber initiation and flowering. Taper off 2 weeks prior to harvest.
plant_care.fertilizer: Rich compost and 10-20-20 fertilizer. High potassium is essential for strong tuber development.
plant_care.sunlight: Full sun (6+ hours). Keep developing tubers well covered with soil or mulch to prevent green solanine toxicity.

plant_care.watering: Maintain shallow standing water (2-5 cm) throughout vegetative growth. Drain field 7-10 days before harvest.
plant_care.fertilizer: Split application of Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium (e.g. 120:60:60 kg/ha NPK) timed with tillering and panicle initiation.
plant_care.sunlight: Abundant full sunlight (7-9 hours) with high solar radiation for maximum photosynthetic grain filling.

plant_care.watering: Deep soaking every 7 to 10 days during dry spells for young trees; mature trees require deep watering during fruit swelling.
plant_care.fertilizer: Apply balanced 10-10-10 fertilizer in early spring just as buds swell. Do not fertilize late in season.
plant_care.sunlight: Full sun (minimum 6-8 hours) for proper floral bud development, disease resistance, and fruit coloring.

plant_care.watering: Deep, infrequent watering during the first two seasons. Avoid excessive watering during ripening to concentrate sugar.
plant_care.fertilizer: Light application of nitrogen in early spring; compost or balanced organic manure every two years.
plant_care.sunlight: Full sunshine for 7-8 hours daily in south-facing or well-ventilated trellised locations.

plant_care.watering: Critical water requirement during tasseling and silking (1.5 inches per week). Never let soil dry out during pollination.
plant_care.fertilizer: Heavy nitrogen feeder. Apply balanced starter fertilizer, then side-dress with nitrogen when plants are knee-high.
plant_care.sunlight: Intense full sun (8 hours daily) in blocks for wind-aided pollination.

plant_care.watering: Keep soil evenly moist but not waterlogged. Water at ground level when top 1 inch feels dry.
plant_care.fertilizer: Balanced 5-10-10 or compost tea once flowers emerge. Avoid high nitrogen which causes all leaves and no peppers.
plant_care.sunlight: Warm, full sun (6 to 8 hours). Peppers thrive in warm soil temperatures above 20°C.
